title: THE X KEY ROW SAYS CALL FOR EXTRACTION, THEN EXTRACT
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: the Keys window row for X and the controls card both read call for extraction, then board. Board is a retired word; his words are ascend and extract. Proven in headless Chromium: the X label in KEYS_ACTS and the LEGEND WORLD row both match /\bboard\b/. Neither string is a TXSHIP key and no existing check quotes it. Both now read call for extraction, then extract: X calls for extraction in a ring, then a second hold extracts (the raid prompt says Hold [X] to extract).
now: The Keys window and the controls card say X calls for extraction, then extracts, without the old word board.
